theorems.name: Submission.cbrcs_ce_leibniz_smul_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k n : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (g : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (x : Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => f y • g y) x‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f x‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n - i) g x‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
